payload.reason: The evidence discusses the lack of actual exposed MIS 5e facies in synthetic well logs compared to preserved fossil reef facies, indicating a preservation bias in the geological record.

claims.text: Actual exposed MIS 5e facies are lacking in synthetic well logs, despite preserved fossil reef facies being present at Lembetabe.
The preservation bias in the geological record is evident as significant lithological sections are removed between the Last Interglacial (LIG) and modern times.
Different modeling scenarios show varying degrees of LIG reef preservation, with some scenarios lacking any LIG reef presence.
